concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies section, 'T009 is [P] once T004-T006 outputs exist'
concerns.text: T009 is declared parallel-safe once T004-T006 outputs exist, but its description requires it to be 'linked to the actual output files (`results/correlations.csv`, `results/validation_correlations.csv`, `figures/*.png`)'. `results/validation_correlations.csv` is produced by T006 (OK) but `figures/*.png` are produced by T007, which is NOT in the stated gate. If T009 runs in parallel after T006 but before T007/T008, it consumes artifacts that do not yet exist. Fix the [P] gate to 'once T004-T008 outputs exist' (or drop [P]).
